target: Use the same fixed 3 deployed skills. Within each of the 10 registered time-prefix windows (74 training questions, two original excluded windows retained), estimate D = F1(relation/pairs) - F1(activity/single). The writer and grouping Shapley means are (S+D)/2 and (S-D)/2, where S is the pre-existing matched pure F1 difference. Crossed actions are diagnostic only. Locked validation and tests remain unopened.
sampling: Record all complete physical question receipts and source packet hashes at one cutoff. Matched receipts and identical hybrid request keys have known D; missing or incompatible receipts cannot be silently dropped. Independently draw at most two other questions without replacement in every window, by SHA256 priority using a once-generated random seed frozen with the sample frame. Retain sampled IDs, probabilities, and unselected IDs. No replacement for failed measurements. No use of evaluation answers to fit.
auxiliary: For each hybrid, predict the old matched F1 of the native question prompt with the higher word-sequence similarity (difflib.SequenceMatcher, autojunk=False, hybrid as first argument). Exact ties use the average native F1. The difference of the two predictions supplies a fixed auxiliary D. Use true D for certainty questions. A prediction-only strategy is a diagnostic, ineligible for promotion.
estimation: For each window, average all fixed auxiliary values and add the unknown stratum's population fraction times the unweighted sampled residual mean. Also report a sample-only (zero auxiliary for unknowns) estimate and the finite-population design variance of the residual correction. No clipping. Publish an initial rollout after one random draw per nonempty stratum, with unknown variance for a noncensus singleton, and a separately frozen two-draw rollout with the design variance. Comparing estimates to the eventual complete matched GPU census must keep all registered windows and reasons for exclusion.
policy: Fit the existing component-specific return heads to those estimated Shapley means with equal-history/window weights, holding out the target dialogue. Use only the three prior rule-2 credit labels and their measured shares. Keep the temporal probability budget and the deployed action set fixed. Compare credit vs identical raw equations with all credit zero, swapped labels, rotated labels, undivided credit, prediction-only, sample-only under the same draws, and prior raw and credit policies. Freeze the 25 later and 12 earliest original decision probabilities and exposure. Only the pre-existing development gates and adequately powered independent panels can establish improvement. Require successful selected deployable-path repeats; omit the entire affected window from the corresponding fit if one fails, and report failure.
reference: Finite-population stratified difference estimator with a fixed auxiliary prediction; related prediction-plus-residual principle: Angelopoulos et al., Science 2023, https://doi.org/10.1126/science.adi6000.
